verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs explicitly mention realtime capabilities (broadcasting online/typing/viewing status, 'Respond to server events in realtime', and databases with 'permissions and realtime'), supporting live-data subscription without polling. However, the evidence pack lacks detailed documentation on the realtime subscription API/channels mechanics and has no independent/hands-on corroboration of it working reliably. Missing for 10: detailed API/channel subscription docs, independent developer confirmation of realtime reliability at scale.
